# Neeraj Kumar

> Neeraj Kumar is a Full Stack Developer (MERN) based in Karachi, Pakistan. Since June 2024 he has worked at Pakistan Agriculture Research (https://par.com.pk), building RBAC admin platforms, secure REST APIs, automated data pipelines and real-time portalswith React, Node.js, Express and MongoDB. He holds a B.S. in Computer Science from DHA Suffa University (2019 to 2024) and is open to full-time roles.

## Key facts

- Role: Full Stack Developer (MERN), Pakistan Agriculture Research, Karachi. June 2024 to present.
- Core stack: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Tailwind CSS, Jest, GitHub Actions.
- Security work: four-tier RBAC (user, admin, super_admin, administrator), JWT auth with httpOnly cookies, Redis-backed session invalidation.
- Results: API response times cut by 40%, organic traffic up 40%, team efficiency up 50%, news bulletins condensed 60 to 70%.
- Contact: neeraj.dsu@gmail.com

## Projects

- Agri Data Portal (live, https://par.com.pk): role-aware data APIs, a React landing page, Mixpanel analytics and ApexCharts market data visualisations.
- Admin Panel (internal): RBAC admin panel with Node/Express APIs, Python scrapers and node-cron automation.
- News Bulletin Automation (internal): multi-source news pipeline delivering bulletins through Amazon SES.
